email.subject: Invoice SBT-25-0187 - MV IVELLE STAR - Bilbao bunkers
email.body:
Dear Operations team,

Please find below our invoice for the bunkers delivered to MV IVELLE STAR at Bilbao on 18 January 2025.

Invoice: SBT-25-0187
Delivered: 380.0 t VLSFO, 45.0 t MGO
Amount due: USD 239,960.00
Payment terms: 30 days from delivery

Bank details (unchanged):
Beneficiary: Solent Bunker Trading Ltd
Bank: Solent Merchant Bank, Southampton
IBAN: GB00 SOMB 0000 0000 0000 00

For any questions please call our accounts desk on +44 20 7946 0884.

Kind regards,
Claire Ashdown
Accounts Receivable
Solent Bunker Trading Ltd

summary: Security Agent finds: sender imitates a known contact

findings.why: The sender domain uses the digit "1" in place of the letter "l" (so1entbunker vs solentbunker), imitating the verified contact accounts@solentbunker.example so a fraudulent invoice appears to come from a known bunker supplier.
